Mohali, Punjab (source: https://www.jcbl.com/ and https://www.jcbl.com/contact-us). No evidence of strike-off, liquidation or bankruptcy was found, therefore NOT rejected; status is 'unverified, pending registry lookup'. Revenue FY25/FY26 left null — no audited accounts or MCA filing was accessible; figures must not be estimated. HS 820600 (hand tools) does not match the actual business (motor-vehicle bodies / special application vehicles, i.e. Ch.87); per project rule this is NOT a rejection ground — the code should be corrected to the factual one and the company kept in the base. Recommended next step: re-run against MCA master data / GST portal once search access is restored.
